examples.translation: Blogs about makeup, cosmetic and hygiene products have a healthy and prolific catalog of this type of content, and fashion and accessories bloggers are not deprived of sharing the experience of unboxing a brand new handbag with their public: users will trust the opinion of a youtuber whom they follow more so than an advertisement or a corporative video.
